evidence.quote: DeepSeek is developing its own AI chips to reduce its reliance on products from Nvidia and Huawei
evidence.one_line: DeepSeek is developing its own AI chips to reduce reliance on Nvidia and Huawei, per Reuters citing three sources.
evidence.speaker: Reuters (unnamed sources)
evidence.original_who: three sources familiar with the plans

evidence.quote: DeepSeek's chips are being designed specifically for inference, the stage where trained AI models generate responses for users.
evidence.one_line: DeepSeek's chips reportedly target inference rather than training.
evidence.speaker: Reuters (unnamed sources)
evidence.original_who: three sources familiar with the plans

evidence.quote: The news briefly weighed on Nvidia shares, which fell around 1.6% in US pre-market trading.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia shares fell about 1.6% in US pre-market trading after the report.
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: Nvidia's position in China is effectively at zero and will remain that way.
evidence.one_line: Analyst Richard Windsor says Nvidia's China position is effectively zero and will stay there.
evidence.speaker: Richard Windsor, Radio Free Mobile

evidence.quote: Huawei has expanded its domestic market share and now controls around half of China's AI chip market, which is valued at approximately US$50 billion.
evidence.one_line: Huawei reportedly controls about half of China's AI chip market, valued at about US$50 billion.
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: OpenAI introduced its first inference chip, called Jalapeno, last month in collaboration with Broadcom
evidence.one_line: OpenAI introduced its first inference chip, Jalapeno, with Broadcom last month.
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: DeepSeek's chip development project remains at an early stage.
evidence.one_line: DeepSeek's chip project is at an early stage, per Reuters sources.
evidence.speaker: Reuters (unnamed sources)

evidence.quote: The base model supporting DeepSeek R1 was trained using Nvidia's H800 chips, a product specifically designed for the Chinese market before the US government banned its export in late 2023.
evidence.one_line: DeepSeek's R1 base model was trained on Nvidia H800 chips before the US export ban in late 2023.
evidence.speaker: Reuters
